correctness.rationale: The exact matrix count is obtained by classifying products bc=z over Z/p^e, correctly isolating the extra p^{e-1}R_e at z=0. Haar integration of root distances and explicit odd-prime/dyadic proximity tables prove both the limit and equality criteria, including multiple roots. 500 independent direct counts and 22 high-level rational convergence tests corroborate arithmetic; universal claims rest on proof.
